content: MK observes that Niʿmat Allāh, Qāsim-i Anvār and Aḥmad Samarqandī were all known as promoters of Ibn ʿArabī in the face of sometimes hostile reaction, and suggests this was a point of intellectual attraction for Ṣāʾin al-Dīn.
refers_to_primary: MK on the first three Sufis of the Munshaʾāt list
